item.title: Loud sounds like the back fire from a car presumably from lamp post, 21st August
item.description:
Dear Bexley Council, For the past 2-3 months, I have been hearing intermittent and random electrical like sounds ( sometimes quite loud and sometimes muffled) coming from the direction of the lamp post that lights the footpath to Lamorbey Close from Halfway Street in Sidcup. The sound is often brief and very much like the sound of a car backfiring. I have heard it in the day time as well as night. This MAY be an issue with the street lighting or not because I can't see anything only hear. Either way, please investigate as this footpath is frequently used by pedestrians. Thank you
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Lamorbey Close, Longlands, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
